channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities reveal a high-volume threat environment characterized by numerous remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws targeting core enterprise systems. Microsoft ecosystems bear the brunt of these risks, with critical heap overflows, authentication bypasses, and deserialization issues affecting Windows operating systems, Azure cloud services, Exchange Server, and SQL Server. Beyond proprietary software, open-source and third-party tools face severe exploitation vectors, including unauthenticated RCEs in router firmware, dangerous injection flaws in ASP.NET Core and Python's Pillow library, and database compromises in Splunk and Apache Pulsar.
